name: HybridZip R2 predictive Silesia prefix experiment
description: HybridZip HZ02 block portfolio mode predictive on Silesia 32/64/128 KiB prefixes.
model_structure: HZ02 donor-driven block portfolio with representation, specialist, neural, LZ, and multi-coder candidates.
change_from_baseline: Uses HZ02 mode predictive instead of the fixed HZ01 PROFILE_V1 full-file path.
hypothesis: The block portfolio should retain byte-exact reconstruction and choose only payloads smaller than stored in auto mode.
baseline_description: Product comparison uses available gzip, zstd, brotli, xz, and 7-Zip binaries on identical bytes.
environment: Windows 10.0.19045.0; CPU=12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12650H; sequential execution
notes: archive_bytes includes the complete HZ02 archive header, every block header, CRC32 metadata, backend envelope, and payload.
